words.tr: n. 需优先考虑的事；优先权；
words.ex: Homework is my top priority.
words.ex_cn: 作业是我最需要优先考虑的事。
words.en: If something is a priority, it is the most important thing you have to do or deal with, or must be done or dealt with before everything else you have to do.

words.ex: This plant has medicinal properties.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物具有药用价值。
words.en: Having healing properties; used in the treatment of disease.

words.ex: He is learning neuroscience at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学学习神经科学。
words.en: The scientific study of the nervous system, especially the brain.

words.ex: He actively participates in class discussions.
words.ex_cn: 他积极参加课堂讨论。
words.en: In a way that involves positive action or participation.

words.ex: There is a pile of books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一堆书。
words.en: A pile of things is a quantity of them lying on top of one another. If you pile things somewhere, you put them there so that they form a pile.

words.tr: adj. 平流层的；同温层的
words.ex: The stratospheric layer protects us from UV rays.
words.ex_cn: 平流层保护我们免受紫外线的伤害。
words.en: Relating to the stratosphere or extremely high in level or degree.

words.ex: Handwashing is a simple prevention of disease.
words.ex_cn: 洗手是预防疾病的一种简单方法。
words.en: The act of stopping something from happening or arising.

words.ex: The baker used a metal mold to shape the cake.
words.ex_cn: 面包师用一个金属模具来塑造蛋糕。
words.en: A mold is a hollow container used to give shape to molten or hot liquid material when it cools and hardens. It can also refer to a fungus that grows on food or damp surfaces.

words.ex: He tied his shoelace before running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步前系好了鞋带。
words.en: A shoelace is a cord or strip of leather used to fasten a shoe.

words.tr: phrase. 因果关系；表示一个事件（原因）导致另一个事件（结果）的关系
words.ex: Smoking has a causal relationship with lung cancer.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟与肺癌之间存在因果关系。
words.en: A causal relationship is a relationship between two variables in which one variable is the cause of the other.

words.tr:
v. 引导；领导；带头；
n. 主导地位；铅；领先；
words.ex: The teacher leads the students to the library.
words.ex_cn: 老师带领学生去图书馆。
words.en: To be in charge of a group, country, or situation; to guide or direct in a course; a position of advantage in a contest or competition; a heavy, malleable, ductile, bluish-white, dense metallic element.

words.ex: The government punished the official for corruption.
words.ex_cn: 政府因贪污惩罚了那名官员。
words.en: Corruption is dishonest or illegal behavior, especially by people in positions of power.

words.ex: Stay put until I come back.
words.ex_cn: 我回来之前原地待着。
words.en: To remain in one place and not move.

words.ex: The dove is a symbol of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征。
words.en: A symbol is a shape or design that is used to represent something such as an idea, a quality, or a process.

words.ex: The caterpillar will transform into a butterfly.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫会变成蝴蝶。
words.en: To change something completely, usually to improve it, or to change into something else.

words.ex: The hotel gave us complimentary breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 酒店免费赠送了我们早餐。
words.en: If something is complimentary, it is given or done free of charge. It can also mean expressing a compliment; praising or approving.

words.ex: The bird uses mimicry to copy other animals' sounds.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟通过模仿来复制其他动物的声音。
words.en: The action or art of imitating someone or something, especially in order to entertain or ridicule.

words.ex: The painting depicts a quiet village at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画描绘了一个宁静的村庄在日落时分的景象。
words.en: To depict someone or something means to show or represent them in a work of art such as a drawing or painting.

words.ex: It is rational to save money for the future.
words.ex_cn: 为未来存钱是合理的。
words.en: Based on or in accordance with reason or logic.

words.tr: adj. 未经授权的；未经许可的
words.ex: He used an unauthorised key to enter the building.
words.ex_cn: 他用一把未经许可的钥匙进入了大楼。
words.en: Done without permission or approval.

words.ex: His contribution helped the team win.
words.ex_cn: 他的贡献帮助团队赢得了比赛。
words.en: A contribution is a gift or payment to a common fund or collection, or the part played by a person or thing in bringing about a result or helping something to advance.

words.tr: n. 工艺；手艺；行业；航空器；
words.ex: The craft of pottery takes years to learn.
words.ex_cn: 陶艺工艺需要多年才能掌握。
words.en: Skill in making things by hand; the skilled practice of a practical occupation; the skilled production of decorative or functional objects.

words.tr: adj. 可管理的；可应付的；可处理的；
words.ex: The project is manageable if we work together.
words.ex_cn: 如果我们一起合作，这个项目是可以管理的。
words.en: If you describe something as manageable, you mean that it is easy to control or deal with.

words.ex: The mountain is immense.
words.ex_cn: 这座山非常巨大。
words.en: Extremely large or great, especially in scale or degree.

words.ex: The bird uses its beak to eat seeds.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟用它的喙吃种子。
words.en: The hard, pointed, often curved part of a bird's mouth, used for picking up and eating food.

words.ex: His absence of interest made the teacher sad.
words.ex_cn: 他对学习的缺乏兴趣让老师感到难过。
words.en: The state of being away from a place or person.

words.ex: The school made an announcement about the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 学校发布了关于假期的通告。
words.en: A public or formal notice about something that has happened or is going to happen.

words.ex: The company is heavily reliant on its top salesperson.
words.ex_cn: 公司非常依赖其顶尖销售人员。
words.en: To depend on someone or something for support, help, or supply.

words.ex: He uses analytic methods to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他使用解析方法来解决这个问题。
words.en: Analytic refers to the process of breaking down complex information or substances into smaller parts in order to understand or examine them.

words.tr: phrase. 能够做某事；有能力完成
words.ex: She will be able to attend the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 她将能够参加明天的会议。
words.en: To have the power, skill, means, or opportunity to do something.

words.tr:
n. 酸；
adj. 酸性的；
words.ex: The acid in lemon juice tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 柠檬汁中的酸味道很酸。
words.en: An acid is a chemical substance, usually a liquid, which contains hydrogen and can react with other substances to form salts. Some acids burn or dissolve other substances that they come into contact with.

words.ex: He made a gesture of welcome with his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用手做了一个欢迎的姿态。
words.en: A gesture is a movement that you make with a part of your body, especially your hands, to express emotion or information.

words.ex: The new shelf does not fit into the corner.
words.ex_cn: 这个新架子放不进角落里。
words.en: If you fit into a group or situation, you seem to belong there because you are similar to the other people involved.

words.tr: phrase. 搭便车者；指享受集体利益却不付出相应成本的人
words.ex: The concept of a free rider is often criticized in economic discussions.
words.ex_cn: 搭便车者的概念在经济讨论中经常受到批评。
words.en: A free rider is someone who benefits from resources, goods, or services without paying for the cost of the benefit, thus taking advantage of the efforts of others.

words.tr: n. 民间故事；民间传说
words.ex: My grandmother told me a folktale before bedtime.
words.ex_cn: 我奶奶在我睡觉前给我讲了一个民间故事。
words.en: A folktale is a story originating in popular culture, typically passed on by word of mouth.

words.ex: The rule applies broadly across all schools.
words.ex_cn: 这个规定广泛适用于所有学校。
words.en: In a general way; without considering details.

words.ex: The river is contaminated by factory waste.
words.ex_cn: 这条河被工厂废料污染了。
words.en: To contaminate something means to make it impure or polluted by contact or mixture with something unclean or harmful.

words.tr: n. 热心者；热衷于…的人
words.ex: He is an enthusiast of basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他是篮球的爱好者。
words.en: An enthusiast is a person who is very interested in a particular activity or subject and who spends a lot of time on it.

words.ex: His disposition is calm and kind.
words.ex_cn: 他的性情平静而善良。
words.en: Someone's disposition is the way that they tend to behave or feel.

words.tr: phrase. 充满；挤满（尤指人或生物）
words.ex: The park swarms with people on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 公园在周末挤满了人。
words.en: To be full of or crowded with (people or things).

words.tr: phrase. 在……意义上；就……而言；意思是
words.ex: He is late, in the sense that he missed the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，意思是说他没赶上公交车。
words.en: used to explain in what way you mean something

words.tr: adj. 大量的；重大的；实质性的；
words.ex: He made a substantial profit from the sale.
words.ex_cn: 他从这次销售中获得了大量的利润。
words.en: Something that is substantial is large in size, amount, or importance.

words.ex: He suffered from a bad cold last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周患了重感冒。
words.en: To experience something unpleasant, such as injury, pain, or loss.

words.ex: I'm tired; in other words, I need to rest.
words.ex_cn: 我累了；换句话说，我需要休息。
words.en: Used to introduce a different way of saying the same thing, often to make it clearer or more understandable.

words.ex: The elderly man walks slowly with a cane.
words.ex_cn: 这位年老的男子拄着拐杖慢慢走。
words.en: An elderly person is someone who is old or aging.

words.ex: The implementation of the new rule took one month.
words.ex_cn: 新规则的履行花了一个月。
words.en: The act of putting a decision or plan into effect; execution.

words.ex: The bird lives in a small cage.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟住在一个小笼子里。
words.en: A cage is a structure of wire or metal bars in which birds or animals are kept.

words.tr: phrase. 将…系在…上；把…与…联系起来
words.ex: He needs to tie to the dock before the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他需要在风暴来临前把船系到码头。
words.en: To connect or link something to something else, often implying a strong or necessary relationship.

words.tr: phrase. 对...的关心；对...表示忧虑
words.ex: Parents have concern about their child's safety.
words.ex_cn: 父母对孩子的安全感到担心。
words.en: If you concern about something, you feel worried about it.

words.ex: He uses logic to solve the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 他用逻辑来解决这个谜题。
words.en: Logic is a method of reasoning that involves a series of statements, each of which must be true if the statement before it is true.

words.ex: He works remotely from home.
words.ex_cn: 他从家远程工作。
words.en: If something is done remotely, it is done from a distance, usually by means of technology.

words.ex: The museum displays ancient artefacts from Egypt.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展出了来自埃及的古代人工制品。
words.en: An object made or modified by humans, typically of historical or cultural interest, such as a tool, weapon, or ornament.

words.ex: They pull together to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他们齐心协力按时完成项目。
words.en: To work together as a team or group in order to achieve something.

words.ex: The bank did a valuation of the house.
words.ex_cn: 银行对这所房子进行了评估。
words.en: The process of estimating or determining the value of something, often used in finance and real estate to assess the worth of assets, companies, or properties.

words.tr:
v. 拼写；意味着；
n. 一段时间；
words.ex: Can you spell your name?
words.ex_cn: 你能拼出你的名字吗？
words.en: If you spell a word, you write or speak each letter in the correct order.

words.tr: adj. 不多的；适度的；谦虚的；
words.ex: He made a modest profit last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年的利润不多。
words.en: If you say that someone is modest, you approve of them because they do not talk much about their abilities or achievements.

words.tr: phrase. 引起……的注意；吸引……的目光
words.ex: The red flower catch the eye of the little girl.
words.ex_cn: 那朵红花吸引了小女孩的注意。
words.en: To attract someone's attention.

words.ex: The farmer used a drone to check his crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民用无人驾驶飞机检查他的庄稼。
words.en: A drone is a male bee that does not work and exists solely to mate with the queen bee. It can also refer to an unmanned aircraft or ship guided by remote control or onboard computers. Additionally, 'drone' can describe a continuous low humming sound or to speak in a monotonous tone.

words.ex: There was a large influx of tourists during the summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天期间涌入了大量游客。
words.en: An influx of people or things is a large number of them arriving somewhere at the same time.

words.ex: This park is an ecological habitat for many birds.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园是许多鸟类的生态栖息地。
words.en: Relating to or concerned with the relation of living organisms to one another and to their physical surroundings.

words.ex: The forest is a healthy ecosystem.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林是一个健康的生态系统。
words.en: An ecosystem is a complex network or interconnected system, especially one that involves a community of living organisms in conjunction with their environment.

words.ex: He stayed awake all night to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他整晚醒着完成作业。
words.en: If you are awake, you are not sleeping. If you awake, you wake up.

words.ex: The prosecution brought evidence against the suspect.
words.ex_cn: 起诉方提供了针对嫌疑人的证据。
words.en: The act or process of holding a trial against a person who is accused of a crime to see if they are guilty.

words.ex: I can detect a change in her mood.
words.ex_cn: 我能察觉到她情绪的变化。
words.en: To detect something means to find it or discover it, often using special equipment or methods.

words.ex: The experiment demonstrates that water boils at 100°C.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验证明水在100摄氏度时沸腾。
words.en: To demonstrate means to show something clearly by giving proof or evidence.

words.ex: The emergence of new technology changed our lives.
words.ex_cn: 新技术的出现改变了我们的生活。
words.en: The process of coming into view or becoming exposed after being concealed.

words.ex: He bind the books with string.
words.ex_cn: 他用绳子把书捆起来。
words.en: To tie something or someone tightly or to fasten something.

words.tr: n. 甜食；糖果；调制；精美作品
words.ex: He bought a confection at the candy store.
words.ex_cn: 他在糖果店买了一颗糖果。
words.en: A confection is a sweet food or a delicacy made with sugar or other sweeteners.

words.ex: The essence of love is caring for others.
words.ex_cn: 爱的本质是关心他人。
words.en: The essence of something is its basic and most important characteristic which gives it its individual identity.

words.tr: phrase. 意指；通过…表示；用…表达（某含义）
words.ex: What do you mean by that?
words.ex_cn: 你那是什么意思？
words.en: To intend or mean by a particular word, phrase, or statement.

words.ex: The police opened an enquiry into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方对这起事故展开了调查。
words.en: An enquiry is a question you ask in order to get some information.

words.ex: We waited in the lounge before our flight.
words.ex_cn: 我们在登机前等在休息室里。
words.en: A lounge is a room in a house or public building where people can sit and relax. As a verb, to lounge means to lie, sit, or stand in a relaxed or lazy way.

words.ex: It is said that the new restaurant is very good.
words.ex_cn: 据说那家新餐厅非常好。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is claimed by some people to be the case, although there may be no proof.

words.tr: adj. 务实的；实事求是的；
words.ex: He took a pragmatic approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他采取了务实的方法来解决问题。
words.en: Dealing with things sensibly and realistically in a way that is based on practical rather than theoretical considerations.

words.ex: The hikers got lost in the wilderness.
words.ex_cn: 徒步旅行者在荒野中迷路了。
words.en: A wilderness is a wild and uncultivated region, as of forest or desert, uninhabited or inhabited only by wild animals.

words.ex: He is exceptionally good at math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面异常出色。
words.en: To an unusual degree; extremely.

words.ex: The benefits outweigh the risks.
words.ex_cn: 好处超过了风险。
words.en: If one thing outweighs another, the first thing is of greater importance, benefit, or significance than the second thing.

words.tr: n. 民间传说；民俗学；民间风俗；
words.ex: The old man told us a folklore about a dragon living in the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 老人给我们讲了一个关于住在山里的龙的民间传说。
words.en: Folklore is the traditional stories, customs, and habits of a particular community or nation.

words.ex: He was late due to traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: If an event is due to something, it happens or exists as a direct result of that thing.

words.ex: He is a diplomatic ambassador who handles international relations.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位处理国际关系的外交大使。
words.en: Diplomatic means relating to diplomacy or diplomats, or using skill and tact in dealing with people.

words.tr:
n. 灰色；
adj. 灰色的；暗淡的；
words.ex: The sky turned gray before the rain.
words.ex_cn: 下雨前，天空变成了灰色。
words.en: Gray is an intermediate color between black and white, often associated with gloom or dullness.

words.ex: The accident was a serious incident.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是一起严重事件。
words.en: An incident is an event that is either unpleasant or unusual.

words.ex: He owes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归功于努力工作。
words.en: If you owe money to someone, they have lent it to you and you have not yet paid it back. You can also say that you owe someone a debt of gratitude if they have helped you in a way that you feel you should thank them for.

words.tr: phrase. 成绩记录；（多年的）成就或业绩的记录
words.ex: He has an impressive track record in the field of engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他在工程领域有着令人印象深刻的过往成就。
words.en: A track record is the past achievements or performance of a person, organization, or thing that are used as a guide to their likely future success.

words.ex: The monk meditates every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位僧侣每天早上冥想。
words.en: A monk is a member of a religious community of men who live by certain vows and usually wear a habit.

words.ex: The doctor checked his pulse with his fingers.
words.ex_cn: 医生用手指检查了他的脉搏。
words.en: A pulse is the regular beating of the heart, especially when it is felt at the wrist or neck. It can also refer to a single vibration or short burst of sound, electric current, light, etc.

words.tr: adj. 杰出的；尚未处理的；
words.ex: He is an outstanding student who always gets top grades.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名杰出的学生，总是取得最高分。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as outstanding, you think that they are very remarkable and impressive.

words.ex: The ghost is invisible to the human eye.
words.ex_cn: 这个鬼魂肉眼看不见。
words.en: If something is invisible, you cannot see it because it is hidden or because it is very difficult to see.

words.ex: Her dress showed great elegance.
words.ex_cn: 她的裙子展现了极大的优雅。
words.en: Elegance is the quality of being graceful and stylish in appearance or manner.

words.ex: He lost all his property in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中失去了所有财产。
words.en: Something owned; a possession.

words.tr:
n. 购买；采购；
v. 购买；采购；
words.ex: The purchase of a new car took all his savings.
words.ex_cn: 买一辆新车花光了他所有的积蓄。
words.en: To purchase something means to buy it. It can also refer to something that has been bought.

words.tr: phrase. 自然选择；物竞天择
words.ex: Birds with strong beaks survive by natural selection.
words.ex_cn: 喙强的鸟通过自然选择生存下来。
words.en: The process by which forms of life having traits that better enable them to adapt to specific environmental pressures, as predators, changes in climate, or competition for food or mates, will tend to survive and reproduce in greater numbers than others of their kind, thus ensuring the perpetuation of those favorable traits in succeeding generations.

words.ex: Babies have an innate ability to cry.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿生来就有哭泣的能力。
words.en: An innate quality or ability is one that you were born with, not one you have learned.

words.ex: The marine birds fly over the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这些海鸟在海面上飞翔。
words.en: Marine is used to describe things relating to the sea or to the ships and boats which sail on it.

words.tr:
n. 地址；演讲；
v. 解决；向…讲话；
words.ex: Please write your address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的地址写在表格上。
words.en: The particulars of the place where someone lives or an organization is situated; a formal speech delivered to an audience.

words.ex: The bright light stimulated her eyes.
words.ex_cn: 强烈的光线刺激了她的眼睛。
words.en: To stimulate something means to encourage it to begin or develop further.

words.tr: phrase. 怀着……的希望；期望能够；以期
words.ex: He waited outside the house in the hope of seeing her.
words.ex_cn: 他在房子外面等着，希望能见到她。
words.en: with the desire or expectation that something will happen

words.ex: This is a biological experiment.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个生物学实验。
words.en: Relating to biology or living organisms.

words.ex: The worker had long exposure to loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 这名工人长期暴露在噪音中。
words.en: The condition of being exposed to something, especially to something harmful or unpleasant.

words.tr: v. 促进；使便利；使容易；
words.ex: The teacher facilitates learning by asking questions.
words.ex_cn: 老师通过提问来促进学习。
words.en: To make an action or process easier or more likely to happen.

words.ex: The movie tries to titillate the audience with spicy scenes.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影试图用煽情的场景来挑逗观众。
words.en: To titillate someone means to excite or stimulate them, often in a sexual way, but it can also refer to arousing interest or curiosity in a non-sexual context.

words.tr: n. 描绘；描述；描写；展现方式；
words.ex: The movie's portrayal of love is very touching.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影对爱情的描绘非常感人。
words.en: A portrayal of someone or something is a description or depiction of them in a particular way.

words.tr: n. 药物；药物治疗；药物处理；
words.ex: He took his medication every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃药。
words.en: Medication refers to a substance used for medical treatment, especially a medicine or drug.

words.ex: The teacher will critique the student's essay tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会对学生的作文发表评论。
words.en: A critique is a detailed analysis and assessment of something, especially a literary, philosophical, or political theory.

words.ex: He was arrested for perpetrating a fraud.
words.ex_cn: 他因实施诈骗而被逮捕。
words.en: If someone perpetrates a crime or any other immoral or harmful act, they do it.

words.ex: She gave the furniture a thorough dusting.
words.ex_cn: 她彻底地给家具除尘。
words.en: The act of removing dust or applying a fine powder.

words.ex: He remembers those halcyon days of childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他怀念那些童年的宁静时光。
words.en: A halcyon time is a time in the past that was peaceful or happy.

words.ex: Italian cuisine is famous for pasta and pizza.
words.ex_cn: 意大利烹调风格以意大利面和披萨闻名。
words.en: A style or method of cooking, especially as characteristic of a particular country, region, or establishment.

words.ex: The transition from school to work was hard for him.
words.ex_cn: 从学校到工作的转变对他来说很难。
words.en: The process or a period of changing from one state or condition to another.

words.tr: n. （单位面积或体积内的）生物量
words.ex: The farm uses biomass to make heat.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场用生物质来制造热量。
words.en: Biomass refers to the total mass of living organisms in a given area or volume, or organic material that comes from plants and animals, and it is a renewable energy source.

words.ex: The editorialist criticized the government's new policy in the newspaper.
words.ex_cn: 这位主笔在报纸上批评了政府的新政策。
words.en: An editorialist is a person who writes editorials, which are articles in a newspaper or magazine that give the opinion of the editor or publisher on a topic of current interest.

words.ex: Thanks to his help, I passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 多亏了他的帮助，我通过了考试。
words.en: used to say that something good has happened because of someone or something

words.tr: adj. 公式的；俗套的；刻板的
words.ex: His answer was too formulaic.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答太公式化了。
words.en: If you describe a way of saying or doing something as formulaic, you are criticizing it because it is not original and has been used many times before in similar situations.

words.tr: n. 爱好者；热衷者；信徒
words.ex: He is a music devotee and listens to songs every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是音乐爱好者，每天都听歌曲。
words.en: A devotee is a person who is very interested in and enthusiastic about someone or something.

words.ex: Many children suffer from poverty in poor countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多孩子在贫穷国家遭受贫困。
words.en: Poverty is the state of being extremely poor.

words.ex: He likes coffee, whereas she prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，然而她更喜欢茶。
words.en: You use whereas to introduce a comment which contrasts with what is said in the main clause.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；创立；设立；架起；提出
words.ex: He set up a small shop last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年开了一家小商店。
words.en: To set up something means to establish it or arrange it.

words.tr: phrase. 解开，理顺（线索、问题等）; 通过或仿佛通过使用尖锐工具解开或释放，获得（信息、答案等）
words.ex: We need to tease out the real reason for the problem.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要找出问题的真正原因。
words.en: To tease out means to separate or extract something with difficulty, especially information or a solution to a problem.

words.tr:
n. 逃学者；旷课者
adj. 逃学的；怠惰的
v. 逃学；旷课
words.ex: He is truant from school today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天逃学了。
words.en: A truant is a student who stays away from school without permission.

words.tr: phrase. 在…附近；与…非常接近
words.ex: The house is in close proximity to the school.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子紧挨着学校。
words.en: very near to something or someone.

words.ex: The cumulative score is the total of all previous points.
words.ex_cn: 累积得分是所有之前分数的总和。
words.en: If a series of events have a cumulative effect, each event makes the effect greater.

words.tr: v. 预想；事先想好；预先形成
words.ex: He preconceives that all teachers are strict.
words.ex_cn: 他先入为主地认为所有老师都很严格。
words.en: To form an opinion or idea about something before having enough information or experience.

words.tr:
n. 意图；目的；
adj. 专注的；
words.ex: His intent was to help, not to hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他的意图是帮助，而不是伤害。
words.en: If you are intent on doing something, you are determined to get it done. If you have an intent to do something, you have a plan or purpose in mind.

words.tr: adv. 似乎；看似；表面上看；
words.ex: He is seemingly calm, but he is nervous inside.
words.ex_cn: 他似乎很平静，但内心很紧张。
words.en: appearing to be true or real but not necessarily so

words.tr: phrase. 持有某种观点或看法
words.ex: He decided to take a view on the matter after considering all the facts.
words.ex_cn: phr. 在考虑了所有事实后，他决定对这件事持有某种看法。
words.en: To form or hold an opinion or judgment about something.

words.tr: phrase. 依次；轮流；结果；反过来
words.ex: The students spoke in turn to answer the teacher's question.
words.ex_cn: 学生们依次回答老师的问题。
words.en: You use in turn to refer to actions or events that are in a sequence one after the other, especially because one causes the other.

words.ex: The water goes through filtration to remove dirt.
words.ex_cn: 水经过过滤以去除杂质。
words.en: The process of passing a liquid through a filter to remove solid particles or other impurities.

words.ex: The fish swim above the seabed.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在海床上方游动。
words.en: The seabed is the bottom of the ocean, consisting of various sediments and rocks.

words.ex: This is an evolutionary change in the species.
words.ex_cn: 这是该物种的一种进化的改变。
words.en: Relating to or denoting processes of development or growth, especially in a biological context.

words.ex: She was scissoring the paper into small pieces.
words.ex_cn: 她正在将纸剪成小片。
words.en: The act of cutting or dividing something with scissors.

words.ex: He plays the accordion at the street festival.
words.ex_cn: 他在街头音乐节上演奏手风琴。
words.en: An accordion is a musical instrument that you play by pressing keys or buttons on one side and pulling and pushing a bellows on the other side to force air through reeds, producing notes.

words.ex: Subtract 5 from 10 to get 5.
words.ex_cn: 从10中减去5得到5。
words.en: If you subtract one number from another, you take the first number away from the second.

words.ex: Interspecific competition is common in nature.
words.ex_cn: 种类间的竞争在自然界中很常见。
words.en: Involving or occurring between different species.

words.ex: His dominance in the game surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的支配表现让所有人感到惊讶。
words.en: Dominance is the state of being more powerful, important, or noticeable than other people or things.

words.ex: The popularity of this song grew quickly on social media.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌在社交媒体上的流行迅速增长。
words.en: The state or condition of being liked, admired, or supported by many people.

words.tr: adj. 讲究实际的；头脑清晰的；不感情用事的
words.ex: He is hard-headed and refuses to change his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他很固执，拒绝改变主意。
words.en: Unwilling to change one's opinion or be persuaded; stubborn.

words.ex: He missed three consecutive days of school.
words.ex_cn: 他连续三天没上学。
words.en: Consecutive events, numbers, etc. follow one after another without an interruption.

words.ex: The child imitates her mother's voice.
words.ex_cn: 孩子模仿她妈妈的声音。
words.en: If you imitate someone, you copy what they do or produce.

words.ex: The newborn baby slept quietly in its mother's arms.
words.ex_cn: 新生的婴儿安静地躺在母亲的怀里。
words.en: A newborn baby or animal has recently been born.

words.ex: The cloud floats high in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 云朵在天空中飘浮。
words.en: A cloud is a visible mass of condensed water vapor floating in the atmosphere, typically high above the ground.

words.ex: Vaccines help build immunity against diseases.
words.ex_cn: 疫苗有助于增强对疾病的免疫力。
words.en: Immunity is the state of being immune from or insusceptible to a particular disease or the legal status of being exempt from certain obligations or penalties.

words.ex: The molten lava flowed down the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 熔化的岩浆从山上流下。
words.en: Molten is used to describe substances that have been heated to a very high temperature and have turned into a liquid.

words.ex: In future, I will be more careful with my spending.
words.ex_cn: 从今以后，我会更加小心我的开支。
words.en: From now on; at a future time.

words.tr: phrase. 从上到下；彻底地；完全地
words.ex: He cleaned the room from top to bottom.
words.ex_cn: 他从上到下把房间打扫了一遍。
words.en: From the highest point to the lowest point; completely or thoroughly.

words.ex: The soldiers crossed the river on a pontoon.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们通过一座浮桥渡过了河。
words.en: A pontoon is a flat-bottomed boat or a floating structure used as a bridge, dock, or platform.

words.tr:
v. 治疗；对待；
n. 款待；
words.ex: The doctor will treat his fever with medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生会用药物治疗他的发烧。
words.en: If you treat someone or something in a particular way, you behave towards them or deal with them in that way.

words.tr: n. 儿童托管；儿童保育；
words.ex: She works in childcare for young children.
words.ex_cn: 她从事幼儿托管工作。
words.en: The care of children, especially by a service or organization.

words.ex: He loves reading science fiction.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读科幻小说。
words.en: Fiction refers to literature in the form of prose, especially novels, that describes imaginary events and people.

words.ex: He lives independently and makes his own decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他独立生活，并自己做决定。
words.en: If one thing or person is independent of another, they are separate and not connected, so that the first one is not affected or influenced by the second.

words.tr: adj. 精力充沛的；热情洋溢的；
words.ex: The exuberant children ran around the park.
words.ex_cn: 那些精力充沛的孩子们在公园里跑来跑去。
words.en: If you are exuberant, you are full of energy, excitement, and cheerfulness.

words.tr: v. 使（尤指不好的情形、体系、信仰）持续、长存；
words.ex: The system perpetuates inequality among the poor.
words.ex_cn: 这个体系使贫困人群的不平等持续存在。
words.en: To perpetuate something means to cause it to continue, especially for a long time.

words.tr: adj. 泛滥的；猖獗的；蔓生的
words.ex: Rumors are rampant in the small town.
words.ex_cn: 谣言在这个小镇上四处流传。
words.en: If you describe something bad, such as a crime or disease, as rampant, you mean that it is very common and is increasing in an uncontrolled way.

words.ex: I presume he will arrive tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我假设他明天会到。
words.en: If you presume that something is the case, you think that it is the case, although you are not certain.

words.tr: n. 办伙食者；提供者；供应商；承办商
words.ex: The purveyor brings food to the school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 办伙食者每天早上给学校送饭。
words.en: A purveyor is a person or company that supplies or provides something, especially food or information.

words.ex: The critic praised the new movie.
words.ex_cn: 这位评论家称赞了这部新电影。
words.en: A critic is a person who expresses opinions about the good and bad qualities of books, films, music, etc.

words.tr: phrase. v. 旨在；针对；以…为目标
words.ex: This program aims at helping poor children.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目旨在帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: If you aim at something, you direct your efforts or actions towards achieving it.

words.ex: He heard about the restaurant by word of mouth.
words.ex_cn: 他通过口口相传知道了这家餐厅。
words.en: Information that is passed from person to person by oral communication.

words.ex: The preliterate society told stories by speaking.
words.ex_cn: 这个前识字社会通过口述来讲述故事。
words.en: Relating to a society or culture that has not yet developed a written language.

words.tr: adj. 专门的；专业的； v. “specialize”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He has a specialized job in computer repair.
words.ex_cn: 他的工作是专门修理电脑的。
words.en: Requiring or involving detailed and specific knowledge or training.

words.tr:
v. 中断；暂停；
n. 停顿下来；
words.ex: The storm halted the flight.
words.ex_cn: 风暴中断了航班。
words.en: to bring or come to a stop; a temporary or permanent stop

words.ex: The region is largely monocultural, with little diversity.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区主要是单一文化，几乎没有多样性。
words.en: Relating to or characterized by the presence of a single culture.

words.ex: He has a monopoly on selling ice cream in this town.
words.ex_cn: 他在这座小镇上垄断了冰淇淋的销售。
words.en: If a company, person, or state has a monopoly on something such as an industry, they have complete control over it, so that it is impossible for others to become involved in it.

words.tr: n. 街坊；四邻；街道；附近地区；
words.ex: I walk my dog in the neighborhood every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上在街坊遛狗。
words.en: A neighborhood is one of the parts of a town where people live.

words.ex: The subterranean tunnel connects two buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这条地下的隧道连接着两栋大楼。
words.en: Existing, occurring, or done under the earth's surface.

words.ex: He visits a religious temple every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都去一座宗教寺庙。
words.en: Relating to or believing in a religion.

words.ex: He tightened the screw with a wrench.
words.ex_cn: 他用扳手把螺丝拧紧。
words.en: If you tighten a rule, policy, or system, you make it stricter or more efficient.

words.ex: The animals found refuge in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这些动物在森林中找到了避难所。
words.en: A place or state of safety or shelter from danger, trouble, or difficulty.

words.ex: He tries to cope with stress by walking every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天散步来应对压力。
words.en: To deal effectively with something difficult.

words.ex: He got a patent for his new invention.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的新发明获得了专利。
words.en: A patent is an official right to be the only person or company allowed to make or sell a new product for a certain period of time.

words.tr: adj. 推测的；推理的；思索的；投机的
words.ex: He made a speculative guess about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他对天气做了一个推测性的猜测。
words.en: Based on conjecture rather than knowledge; involving a high risk of loss.

words.ex: The doctor suggested a natural remedy for the cold.
words.ex_cn: 医生建议了一种治疗感冒的天然疗法。
words.en: A remedy is a cure or a way of making something better.

words.ex: He did a preliminary test before the main experiment.
words.ex_cn: 他在主要实验之前做了一个初步测试。
words.en: Preliminary means something that is done or happens before the main part or event, especially as an introduction or preparation.

words.ex: He sends out emails every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上发送邮件。
words.en: To cause something to go or be taken to a place, especially by post or by email.

words.ex: They cut down the old tree in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 他们把院子里那棵老树砍倒了。
words.en: To reduce the amount, size, or number of something, or to do less of something.

words.tr: n. 朝圣之旅；参拜之行；瞻仰之旅；
words.ex: Many people go on a pilgrimage to the holy city.
words.ex_cn: 许多人前往圣城进行朝圣之旅。
words.en: A pilgrimage is a journey to a holy place for religious reasons.

words.tr: phrase. 与……相关联；与……相互关联
words.ex: Sleep quality often correlates with how well a student does in school.
words.ex_cn: 睡眠质量通常与学生在学校的表现相关。
words.en: If one thing correlates with another, there is a close similarity or connection between them, often because one thing causes the other.

words.ex: The police will investigate the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方将调查这起事故。
words.en: If someone, especially an official, investigates an event, situation, or claim, they try to find out what happened or what is the truth.

words.tr:
adv. 州的北部地区的；；（美国的一州内）远离大城市的
adj. 在州的北部地区；（美国的一州内）远离大城市的地
n. 州内远离大城市的地区；州的北部
words.ex: He lives in upstate New York.
words.ex_cn: 他住在纽约州北部。
words.en: Upstate refers to the northern part of a state, especially in the context of New York State.

words.ex: The radioactivity of the material is dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 这种材料的放射性很危险。
words.en: The emission of ionizing radiation or particles caused by the spontaneous disintegration of atomic nuclei.

words.ex: The plainness of her dress surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 她衣服的朴素让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The quality of being simple, unadorned, or easily understood; lack of ornamentation.

words.ex: The results were statistically significant.
words.ex_cn: 这些结果在统计上是显著的。
words.en: In a way that relates to statistics or the use of statistics.

words.ex: Can you join in the game?
words.ex_cn: 你能加入这个游戏吗？
words.en: If you join in an activity, you take part in it or become involved in it.

words.tr: adv. 古怪地；怪异地；反常地；
words.ex: He dressed oddly for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着古怪地去参加派对。
words.en: In a manner that is strange or unusual.

words.ex: He wants to study psychology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习心理学。
words.en: Psychology is the scientific study of the human mind and the reasons for people's behaviour.

words.tr:
v. 摔跤；扭斗；奋力对付
n. 摔跤；角力；扭斗
words.ex: He tries to wrestle the dog away from the trash.
words.ex_cn: 他试图把狗从垃圾桶旁拉开。
words.en: To engage in a physical contest, typically involving grappling and trying to throw or immobilize the opponent, or to struggle with a difficult problem or decision.

words.ex: The accountant calculated the fair value of the assets.
words.ex_cn: 会计计算了资产的公允价值。
words.en: The price at which an asset would change hands between a willing buyer and a willing seller, neither being under any compulsion to buy or sell and both having reasonable knowledge of relevant facts.

words.ex: The magnet has a magnetic force.
words.ex_cn: 这块磁铁有磁性。
words.en: If you describe something as magnetic, you mean that it is very attractive to people because it has unusual, powerful, and exciting qualities.

words.tr:
v. 装作教皇似地说话；自以为是地谈论；目空一切地议论
n. 教皇职务（或在任时期）
words.ex: He loves to pontificate about politics.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢目空一切地谈论政治。
words.en: To pontificate means to speak or behave in a pompous or dogmatic way, often giving opinions as if they were facts.

words.ex: Fish reproduce in the river.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在河里繁殖。
words.en: To produce something again; to make a copy of something.

words.ex: He tends to arrive late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他总是迟到上课。
words.en: If someone or something tends to do a particular thing, they usually do it or they often do it.

words.ex: The star's luminosity is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这颗恒星的光度很高。
words.en: Luminosity is the intrinsic brightness of a celestial object, or the total amount of energy emitted by a star, galaxy, or other astronomical object per unit time.

words.ex: The box has a cubic shape.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是立方体形状的。
words.en: Relating to or involving the cube or cubes.

words.ex: The child behaves well in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子在课堂上表现得很好。
words.en: To behave means to act in a particular way, especially in a way that is good or correct.

words.ex: The supreme leader makes the final decision.
words.ex_cn: 至上的领导人做出最终决定。
words.en: If you say that something is supreme, you mean that it is the most important or the best of its kind.

words.ex: The dogs had three offspring last spring.
words.ex_cn: 这些狗去年春天生了三只幼崽。
words.en: Someone's offspring are their children.

words.ex: From the point of view of a teacher, homework is essential for learning.
words.ex_cn: 从老师的观点看，家庭作业对学习是必不可少的。
words.en: Considering or according to a particular way of thinking or perspective.

words.ex: The peasant worked in the field every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民每天早上都在田里劳作。
words.en: A peasant is a poor person of low social status who works on the land; used of people who live in countries where farming is still a common way of life.

words.tr:
adj. 联网的；接有电线的；兴奋的；紧张不安的
v. 发电报；装电线；“wire”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He is wired to the computer.
words.ex_cn: 他连接着电脑。
words.en: Connected to the internet or another network by a wire; very excited or nervous.

words.ex: He works in the sales department.
words.ex_cn: 他在销售部工作。
words.en: A department is one of the sections in an organization such as a government, business, or university.

words.tr:
v. 保存；保护；保持；
n. （某群体）专有的活动；
words.ex: She preserves fresh fruit by making jam.
words.ex_cn: 她通过做果酱来保存新鲜水果。
words.en: To preserve something means to maintain it in its original or existing state.

words.tr: adj. 悲剧的；悲惨的；不幸的；
words.ex: The accident was a tragic event.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故是一场悲剧。
words.en: A tragic event or situation is extremely sad, usually because it involves death or suffering.

words.ex: Smallpox caused many deaths in the past.
words.ex_cn: 天花在过去导致了许多人死亡。
words.en: An acute, highly infectious, often fatal disease caused by a poxvirus and characterized by high fever and aches with subsequent widespread eruption of pimples that blister, produce pus, and form pockmarks.

words.ex: Farmers use tillage to prepare the soil for planting.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用耕作来为种植准备土壤。
words.en: The preparation of land for growing crops, especially by plowing.

words.tr: adj. 乌托邦的；空想完美主义的；
words.ex: His plan for a perfect society is utopian.
words.ex_cn: 他关于完美社会的计划是乌托邦式的。
words.en: If you describe a plan or idea as utopian, you are criticizing it because it is unrealistic and shows a belief that things can be improved much more than is possible.

words.tr: adj. 巨大的；大量的；辽阔的；
words.ex: The desert is vast and empty.
words.ex_cn: 这片沙漠巨大而空旷。
words.en: If you describe something as vast, you mean that it is very large.

words.tr: v. 使变得残忍；野蛮对待
words.ex: The dictator used his power to brutalise his opponents.
words.ex_cn: v. 独裁者利用他的权力残忍对待他的反对者。
words.en: To brutalise someone means to treat them in a cruel or violent way.

words.tr:
v. 弄懂；认为；
n. 数字；重要或有名的人物；
words.ex: I couldn't figure out why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 我弄不懂他为什么迟到。
words.en: A figure is a number, a person, a shape, or a form. It can also refer to the process of calculating or appearing in a particular way.

words.ex: He propose to go to the park after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提议午饭后去公园。
words.en: If you propose something, you suggest it as a plan or course of action.

words.ex: He skipped the hard question and moved to the next one.
words.ex_cn: 他略过了难题，继续做下一题。
words.en: To move lightly and quickly, making a small jump after each step.

words.ex: The castle is a medieval building.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡是一座中世纪的建筑。
words.en: Relating to the Middle Ages, the period in European history from about the 5th century to the 15th century.

words.ex: His calmness is the antithesis of her anger.
words.ex_cn: 他的冷静是她愤怒的反面。
words.en: The antithesis of something is its exact opposite.

words.ex: I assume it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我假定明天会下雨。
words.en: If you assume that something is true, you accept that it is true without proof.

words.ex: We get to the park by bus.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘公交车到公园。
words.en: If you get to a particular place, you arrive there. If you get to do something, you have the opportunity to do it. If something gets to you, it affects you emotionally.

words.tr: adj. 有免疫力的；免疫的；不受影响的；
words.ex: Children are immune to this disease after vaccination.
words.ex_cn: 儿童接种疫苗后对这种疾病有免疫力。
words.en: If you are immune to a particular disease, you cannot be affected by it. If you are immune to something such as criticism, it does not affect you.

words.ex: The spectral lines show the elements in the star.
words.ex_cn: 光谱线显示了恒星中的元素。
words.en: Relating to or suggesting a spectrum; especially relating to or suggesting a ghost.

words.ex: They tease him because he wears funny hats.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为他戴滑稽的帽子而戏弄他。
words.en: To tease someone means to make fun of them or try to provoke them in a playful way.

words.tr:
n. 平板；厚板；厚片
v. 切成厚板
words.ex: He broke the slab of concrete with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子砸碎了那块混凝土板。
words.en: A slab is a thick, flat piece of a hard material such as stone, concrete, or wood.

words.ex: Overfishing is hurting the ocean fish.
words.ex_cn: 过度捕捞正在伤害海洋中的鱼类。
words.en: The act of catching too many fish at once, so that the fish population becomes too low to recover.

words.ex: The factory improved its productivity by using new machines.
words.ex_cn: 工厂通过使用新机器提高了生产率。
words.en: Productivity is the rate at which goods are produced or work is completed.

words.tr: phrase. 似乎做某事；看起来好像在做某事
words.ex: He seems to know the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他似乎知道答案。
words.en: to appear to be or do something, especially when this is not true or certain

words.ex: The neuroscientist studies how the brain works.
words.ex_cn: 这位神经科学家研究大脑是如何工作的。
words.en: A neuroscientist is a scientist who specializes in the study of the nervous system, including the brain, spinal cord, and networks of sensory nerve cells called neurons.

words.ex: The inequality between rich and poor is growing.
words.ex_cn: 贫富之间的不平等正在加剧。
words.en: Inequality refers to the unfair situation in society when some people have more opportunities, money, etc. than other people.

words.ex: The inadequacy of food caused many problems.
words.ex_cn: 食物的不足导致了许多问题。
words.en: If there is an inadequacy in something, it is not enough or not good enough.

words.tr: phrase. 被认为是；被当做是
words.ex: He is regarded as a good teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他被认为是一位好老师。
words.en: To be considered or thought of in a specified way.

words.ex: His behavioural changes worried his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他的行为变化让他的父母担心。
words.en: Relating to or involving behaviour.

words.ex: This school uses a progressive teaching method.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校使用一种先进的教学方法。
words.en: A progressive person or idea is one that is modern and new, and is interested in change and improvement.

words.tr:
adj. 复杂的；
n. 综合楼（群）；
words.ex: The instructions are too complex for children.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明对孩子来说太复杂了。
words.en: Something that is complex has many different parts, and is therefore often difficult to understand.

words.ex: The cows graze in the field every morning.
words.ex_cn: 奶牛每天早上在田野里吃草。
words.en: To graze means to feed on grass or to touch something lightly in passing.

words.ex: He stood amid the trees, quiet and still.
words.ex_cn: 他站在树木中间，安静而静止。
words.en: If something is amid other things, it is surrounded by them.

words.ex: The legend says a dragon lives in the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 传说有一条龙住在山里。
words.en: A legend is a very old and popular story that may be true or may be imaginary.

words.ex: The sociocultural factors played a significant role in the development of the community.
words.ex_cn: 社会与文化因素在社区发展中起到了重要作用。
words.en: Relating to the interaction of social and cultural factors.

words.tr: phrase. 一连串的；一系列；一套
words.ex: He made a series of mistakes on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中犯了一连串的错误。
words.en: A number of things or events that are arranged or happen one after the other.

words.tr: adj. 内置的；固有的；天生的
words.ex: The phone has an in-built camera.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机有内置摄像头。
words.en: Existing as a natural or essential part of something.

words.tr: phrase. v. 传递；交给（某人）
words.ex: Please hand on the book to your friend.
words.ex_cn: 请把书递给你的朋友。
words.en: To pass something to someone else, especially so that they can take over a responsibility or duty.

words.tr: n. 不可预测性；不可预见性；
words.ex: The unpredictability of the weather made planning difficult.
words.ex_cn: 天气的不可预测性使规划变得困难。
words.en: The quality of being unable to be predicted; the state of being unpredictable.

words.tr: phrase. 资产负债表（企业财务状况的报表，列明资产、负债和所有者权益）
words.ex: The company shows its balance sheet every year.
words.ex_cn: 公司每年展示它的资产负债表。
words.en: A balance sheet is a financial statement that summarizes a company's assets, liabilities, and shareholders' equity at a specific point in time.

words.ex: The painting is an impressionist style with soft colors.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是印象派风格，色彩柔和。
words.en: An impressionist is an artist who paints in the style of Impressionism, which is characterized by the depiction of light and its changing qualities, ordinary subject matter, and unusual visual angles.

words.ex: He pressed the button to speed up the video.
words.ex_cn: 他按了按钮来加快视频速度。
words.en: To increase the speed or rate of something.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；逐步增长；加强
words.ex: He builds up his strength by running every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天跑步来增强体力。
words.en: To increase or develop something gradually; to accumulate or amass something over time.

words.tr:
adj. 非写实的；程式化的
v. 使风格化； 仿效 ... 的风格；符合（传统）程式；“stylize”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The poster is stylized with bright colors and simple shapes.
words.ex_cn: 这张海报用鲜艳的颜色和简单的形状进行了风格化处理。
words.en: Represented or depicted in a non-realistic or conventional style.

words.tr: phrase. 有偿就业；领薪工作
words.ex: She is looking for paid employment after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 她毕业后正在寻找有薪工作。
words.en: Paid employment refers to work for which one receives monetary compensation.

words.ex: His discourse on climate change was clear and logical.
words.ex_cn: 他关于气候变化的论述清晰而有逻辑。
words.en: Discourse is spoken or written communication between people, especially serious discussion of a particular subject.

words.ex: He was banned from entering the club after causing a disturbance.
words.ex_cn: v. 他因引起骚乱而被禁止进入俱乐部。
words.en: To be officially prohibited from doing something.

words.ex: The king tried to subjugate the rebels.
words.ex_cn: 国王试图征服叛乱者。
words.en: To subjugate a country or group of people means to take complete control of them, especially by defeating them in a war.

words.ex: A cluster of birds flew over the tree.
words.ex_cn: 一群鸟飞过树顶。
words.en: A group of similar things or people positioned or occurring closely together.

words.ex: Too much sugar can result in health problems.
words.ex_cn: 过多的糖会导致健康问题。
words.en: If something results in a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.ex: It's a paradox that he is rich but unhappy.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个悖论，他很富有却不快乐。
words.en: A paradox is a statement that seems to contradict itself but may nonetheless be true, or a situation that defies intuition.

words.tr: adj. 通货膨胀的；引起通胀的
words.ex: The government is worried about inflationary pressures.
words.ex_cn: 政府担心通货膨胀的压力。
words.en: Inflationary means relating to or causing inflation, especially economic inflation.

words.ex: His preeminence in the field of medicine is undisputed.
words.ex_cn: 他在医学领域的卓越地位是毋庸置疑的。
words.en: The state of being superior to all others in status, quality, or importance.

words.ex: He is interested in linguistic patterns in children.
words.ex_cn: 他对儿童的语言模式感兴趣。
words.en: Relating to language or linguistics.

words.ex: He was punished for plagiarism in his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他因论文剽窃而受到惩罚。
words.en: Plagiarism is the practice of using or copying someone else's idea or work and pretending that you thought of it or created it.

words.tr: v. 意识到；认识到；实现；
words.ex: He finally realised his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于意识到自己的错误。
words.en: To realise means to become fully aware of something as a fact; understand clearly. It also means to achieve something desired or anticipated.

words.ex: The cook wiped off the grease from the pan.
words.ex_cn: 厨师把锅上的油脂擦掉了。
words.en: Grease is a thick, oily substance which is put on the moving parts of cars and other machines in order to make them work smoothly.

words.tr: n. 羊皮纸；精制羔皮纸；
words.ex: The ancient book was written on vellum.
words.ex_cn: 这本古书是写在羊皮纸上的。
words.en: Vellum is a fine parchment made originally from the skin of a calf, used for writing or printing on, or for binding books.

words.tr: n. 版画； v. 在（硬物）上雕刻；“engrave”的现在分词；
words.ex: He bought an old engraving at the art market.
words.ex_cn: 他在艺术市场买了一幅古老的版画。
words.en: An engraving is a picture or design that has been cut into a surface.

words.ex: Ancient Egypt is one of the oldest civilizations.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及是最早的文明之一。
words.en: A civilization is a human society with its own social organization and culture.

words.tr: adj. 非自愿的；不由自主的；
words.ex: His hand moved in an involuntary way.
words.ex_cn: 他的手不自觉地动了一下。
words.en: If you make an involuntary movement or exclamation, you make it suddenly and without intending to because you are unable to control yourself.

words.tr: phrase. 使暴露于；使接触（某事物），通常指暴露于危险、影响或环境中
words.ex: Children are often exposed to TV at a young age.
words.ex_cn: 儿童在年幼时经常接触电视。
words.en: To expose someone or something to a particular thing means to put them in a situation where they are affected by it or experience it.

words.tr:
adj. 绣花的
v. 刺绣；绣（花）；加以渲染（或润色）；“embroider”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The dress was embroidered with flowers.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子上绣着花朵。
words.en: Adorned or decorated with needlework.

words.ex: The indigenous people live in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 本土居民住在森林里。
words.en: Indigenous people or things belong to the country in which they are found, rather than coming there or being brought there from another country.

words.ex: The lamp illuminate the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯照亮了黑暗的房间。
words.en: To illuminate something means to shine light on it and to make it brighter and more visible.

words.ex: The volcano erupted last year.
words.ex_cn: 这座火山去年喷发了。
words.en: A volcano is a mountain that opens downward to a pool of molten rock below the surface of the earth. When pressure builds up, eruptions occur.

words.tr: adj. 渴望的；热心的；敏锐的；
words.ex: He is keen to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望学习英语。
words.en: If you are keen on doing something, you very much want to do it. If you are keen that something should happen, you very much want it to happen.

words.ex: He will enrol in the English course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将登记参加英语课程。
words.en: To officially arrange to join a school, university, or course, or to arrange for someone else to do this.

words.tr: n. 迷信；迷信观念（或思想）；
words.ex: He avoids walking under ladders because of superstition.
words.ex_cn: 他因为迷信而不愿从梯子下走过。
words.en: A superstition is a belief or practice resulting from ignorance, fear of the unknown, trust in magic or chance, or a false conception of causation.

words.ex: This chair is very comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子非常舒适。
words.en: If a piece of furniture or an item of clothing is comfortable, it makes you feel physically relaxed when you use it or wear it, for example because it is soft.

words.ex: He must confront his fears.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的恐惧。
words.en: If you confront a difficult situation or issue, you accept the fact that it exists and try to deal with it.

words.ex: He is in trouble for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因为违反规则而陷入麻烦。
words.en: In a situation that is difficult or dangerous.

words.ex: The letter revealed his secret.
words.ex_cn: 这封信揭露了他的秘密。
words.en: To reveal something means to make known something that was previously secret or unknown.

words.ex: Please pay attention to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 请专心听老师讲课。
words.en: If you pay attention to someone or something, you watch, listen to, or think about them carefully.

words.ex: The child's precocity in mathematics was remarkable.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子在数学方面的早熟令人瞩目。
words.en: If you refer to someone's precocity, you mean that they show ability or intelligence at an earlier age than is usual.

words.ex: The queen's reign lasted 70 years.
words.ex_cn: 女王的统治持续了70年。
words.en: The period during which a sovereign rules; to hold royal office; to prevail

words.ex: His neglect of the project caused delays.
words.ex_cn: 他对项目的疏忽导致了延误。
words.en: If you neglect someone or something, you fail to give them the attention or care that they need.

words.tr: adj. 严格的；缜密的；严密的；
words.ex: The teacher is rigorous about homework deadlines.
words.ex_cn: 老师对作业截止日期要求严格。
words.en: If you are rigorous in something, you are very thorough and strict in the way you do it.

words.ex: They have nothing in common.
words.ex_cn: 他们没有什么共同点。
words.en: If two or more people have something in common, they share the same interests or experiences.

words.tr:
n. 模具；霉；
v. 铸造；
words.ex: The clay was poured into the mould to shape the pot.
words.ex_cn: 将黏土倒入模具中以塑造花盆。
words.en: A mould is a hollow container that you pour a liquid or soft substance into, which then becomes solid in the same shape as the container. Mould can also refer to a fungus that grows on old food or on damp surfaces.

words.tr: phrase. 贡献；促成；导致；有助于
words.ex: Volunteers contribute to the clean-up of the park.
words.ex_cn: 志愿者们为公园的清洁做出了贡献。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.tr: phrase. 要么……要么……；不是……就是……（用于连接两个选择）
words.ex: You can have either tea or coffee.
words.ex_cn: 你可以选择茶或咖啡。
words.en: Used before the first of two (or occasionally more) alternatives that are being specified (the other being introduced by ‘or’).

words.tr: phrase. v. 与…联系起来；与…合作；受…牵制
words.ex: The small company may tie up with a bigger one to grow.
words.ex_cn: 这家小公司可能会与一家大公司合作以求发展。
words.en: To form a connection or partnership with someone or something, often for business purposes.

words.ex: He is a genius in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面是个天才。
words.en: Someone who is a genius is a person who is exceptionally intelligent or talented, especially in a particular field.

words.ex: He lingered by the door, not wanting to leave.
words.ex_cn: 他逗留在门口，不想离开。
words.en: If you linger somewhere, you stay there for a longer time than is necessary, for example because you are enjoying yourself.

words.ex: He emphasizes the importance of homework.
words.ex_cn: 他强调作业的重要性。
words.en: To give special importance or prominence to (something) in speaking or writing.

words.ex: The painting has a strong likeness to the real person.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画与真人非常相似。
words.en: The quality or state of being similar to something or someone else.

words.tr: adj. 一致的；始终如一的；
words.ex: His answers are consistent with the data.
words.ex_cn: 他的答案与数据一致。
words.en: Someone who is consistent always behaves in the same way, has the same attitudes towards people or things, or achieves the same level of success in something.

words.ex: The new policy improves worker mobility.
words.ex_cn: 新政策提高了工人的流动性。
words.en: The ability to move or be moved freely and easily.

words.ex: The injury impaired his ability to walk.
words.ex_cn: 这次受伤损害了他走路的能力。
words.en: If something impairs something such as an ability or the way something works, it damages it or makes it worse.

words.ex: The conference aims to bring together experts from various fields.
words.ex_cn: 这次会议旨在汇集来自不同领域的专家。
words.en: To cause people or things to come together in one place or for a common purpose.

words.tr: n. 逃学；旷课；玩忽职守
words.ex: He was punished for truancy last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周因为逃学被惩罚了。
words.en: The action of staying away from school without permission.

words.ex: He noticed the nuance in her voice.
words.ex_cn: 他注意到了她声音中的细微差别。
words.en: A very slight difference in meaning, sound, color, or someone's feelings that is not usually very obvious.

words.tr: phrase. 意识到；察觉到；知道
words.ex: Be aware of the danger near the river.
words.ex_cn: 注意河边的危险。
words.en: To have knowledge or understanding of something.

words.ex: He interrupted me while I was speaking.
words.ex_cn: 我在说话时他打断了我。
words.en: To interrupt someone means to stop them from speaking by saying or doing something, or to cause something to stop happening for a period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 在各种各样的……中；以多种多样的……形式
words.ex: The store offers products in a variety of colors.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供多种颜色的产品。
words.en: Across several or many different categories or kinds.

words.ex: This word derives from Latin.
words.ex_cn: 这个词源自拉丁语。
words.en: To obtain something from a specified source.

words.ex: The neuron sends signals to the brain.
words.ex_cn: 神经元向大脑发送信号。
words.en: A neuron is a cell that is specialized to conduct nerve impulses.

words.ex: The black cat is an omen of bad luck.
words.ex_cn: 黑猫是不祥之兆。
words.en: An omen is an event or phenomenon that is believed to foretell the future, often signifying the advent of change.

words.tr: phrase. 宁可 ... 也不愿；与其 ... 倒不如；而不是
words.ex: He chose to walk rather than take the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他宁愿走路也不愿坐公交车。
words.en: used to say that one thing is preferred to another or happens instead of another

words.ex: The detective used forensic evidence to solve the case.
words.ex_cn: 侦探使用法医证据破了案。
words.en: Relating to or denoting the application of scientific methods and techniques to the investigation of crime.

words.tr: adj. 毁灭性的； v. “devastate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The earthquake caused devastating damage to the city.
words.ex_cn: 地震对这座城市造成了毁灭性的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something as devastating, you are emphasizing that it is very harmful or damaging.

words.tr:
n. 核；核心；重点；
adj. 核心的；
words.ex: The core of the apple is not edible.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的核心不能吃。
words.en: The central or most important part of something.

words.ex: His perception of the sound was very sharp.
words.ex_cn: 他对声音的感知非常敏锐。
words.en: Your perception of something is the way that you think about it or the impression you have of it.

words.ex: The team's cohesion helped them win the match.
words.ex_cn: 团队的凝聚力帮助他们赢得了比赛。
words.en: Cohesion refers to the action or fact of forming a united whole, especially in the context of a group of people or the parts of a substance.

words.ex: He did not respond to the message yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天没有回复那条信息。
words.en: To react or answer to something, such as a question, request, or situation.

words.w: over a long period of time
words.tr: phrase. 经过很长一段时间
words.ex: The ancient ruins have been preserved over a long period of time.
words.ex_cn: 这些古代遗迹经过了很长一段时间的保存。
words.en: For a duration that extends across many years or a significant length of time.

words.ex: The graph shows a linear relationship between time and distance.
words.ex_cn: 这张图显示了时间与距离之间的线性关系。
words.en: Linear means involving or relating to a straight line or lines.

words.ex: The new tool enables him to do the work faster.
words.ex_cn: 这个新工具让他能更快地完成工作。
words.en: To give someone the means or opportunity to do something.

words.ex: He has good spatial skills for drawing maps.
words.ex_cn: 他画地图有很好的空间能力。
words.en: Relating to or occupying space.

words.tr: n. 得罪人的人；犯罪者；违法者；
words.ex: He was punished because he was an offender who hurt his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他因为是一个得罪朋友的人而受到惩罚。
words.en: An offender is a person who commits a crime or does something wrong.

words.ex: The coastal village has beautiful beaches.
words.ex_cn: 这个沿海村庄有美丽的海滩。
words.en: relating to the coast, the area where the land meets the sea

words.ex: He has the capacity to solve hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: The capacity of a place or container is the amount of things or people that it can hold.

words.ex: He will restore the old bike.
words.ex_cn: 他将修复这辆旧自行车。
words.en: To restore something means to bring it back to its original condition or to a state of health, efficiency, or good management.

words.ex: The dog jumped over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 狗跳过了栅栏。
words.en: A fence is a barrier between two areas of land, made of wood or wire supported by posts. If you fence an area of land, you surround it with a fence.

words.tr: 短语，表示失去……的情况，如“失去信心”、“失去控制”等
words.ex: He suffered a loss of hearing after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后失去了听力。
words.en: The phrase 'a loss of' refers to the act or instance of losing something or someone, or the state of no longer having something or someone that you had before.

words.tr: v. 协调；“coordinate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 协调的；
words.ex: She coordinated the meeting last week.
words.ex_cn: 她上周协调了会议。
words.en: If someone is coordinated, they are able to control their movements well.

words.ex: He sows seeds in the garden every spring.
words.ex_cn: 他每年春天都在花园里播种。
words.en: To sow means to plant seeds in the ground so that they will grow into plants.

words.ex: Sugar is an ingredient in this cake.
words.ex_cn: 糖是这个蛋糕的一个成分。
words.en: An ingredient is one of the substances that are combined to make something, especially in cooking.

words.ex: He benefits from eating healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 他从吃健康食品中获益。
words.en: To gain an advantage or profit from something.

words.tr: v. 减到最少；使最小化；
words.ex: Try to minimize waste in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 尽量减少厨房里的浪费。
words.en: To minimize something means to reduce it to the smallest possible amount or degree.

words.tr: phrase. 违反规则；打破规矩
words.ex: He likes to break rules and do what he wants.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢打破规则，做自己想做的事。
words.en: To act in violation of the rules or regulations.

words.ex: He gave a bold speech in front of the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他在众人面前发表了大胆的演讲。
words.en: Someone who is bold is not afraid to do things which involve risk or danger.

words.ex: The ice melts in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 冰在阳光下融化。
words.en: If a solid substance melts or if you melt it, it changes to a liquid, usually because it has been heated.

words.ex: He smiled in response to her question.
words.ex_cn: 他针对她的问题笑了。
words.en: as a reply or reaction to something

words.tr: phrase. 集中（精力；注意力等）于
words.ex: He focuses on his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上专心做作业。
words.en: to direct your attention or effort towards something specific

words.ex: His illness resulted from poor diet and lack of sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他的疾病是由饮食不良和睡眠不足引起的。
words.en: to be caused by something; to happen or exist because of something

words.tr: n. 女用小包；钱包；资金；
words.ex: She put her keys in her purse.
words.ex_cn: 她把钥匙放进她的女用小包里。
words.en: A purse is a small bag used especially by women to carry everyday personal items.

words.ex: He is likely to fail the test.
words.ex_cn: 他很可能考不及格。
words.en: To have a high probability of doing something.

words.ex: He lived in Paris for a decade.
words.ex_cn: 他在巴黎生活了十年。
words.en: A decade is a period of ten years, especially one that begins with a year ending in 0, for example 1980 to 1989.

words.ex: He studies tectonics to understand how buildings are constructed.
words.ex_cn: 他研究筑造学以了解建筑物是如何建造的。
words.en: Tectonics is the study of the Earth's structural features, especially the folding and faulting of the Earth's crust.

words.tr: phrase. 时间用尽；超时；不合时宜；节奏不对
words.ex: He is out of time to finish the test.
words.ex_cn: 他没有时间完成考试了。
words.en: If you are out of time, you have no more time available to do something.

words.ex: He is dependent on his parents for money.
words.ex_cn: 他靠父母给钱生活。
words.en: rely on something or someone for support or existence

words.ex: The Milky Way is our home galaxy.
words.ex_cn: 银河系是我们所在的星系。
words.en: A galaxy is an extremely large group of stars and planets that extends over many billions of light years.

words.tr:
n. 主题；学科；对象；
v. 使臣服；
adj. 易遭受…的；受…支配的；
words.ex: The subject of the book is ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的主题是古代历史。
words.en: A subject is something that is discussed, studied, or written about. It can also refer to a person or thing that is the focus of attention or action. In grammar, a subject is the part of a sentence that performs the action of the verb.

words.ex: He used a compass to find north.
words.ex_cn: 他用指南针找北方。
words.en: A compass is an instrument that you use for finding directions. It has a dial and a magnetic needle that always points to the north.

words.ex: His irresponsibility led to the project's failure.
words.ex_cn: 他的无责任感导致了项目的失败。
words.en: The state or fact of having a duty to deal with something or of having control over someone.

words.tr:
v. 摇摆；摇动；
n. 影响；支配；
words.ex: The tree branches sway in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 树的枝条在风中摇摆。
words.en: To sway means to move slowly or rhythmically backwards and forwards or from side to side. It can also mean to influence someone or something.

words.ex: He gave an oral report in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上做了口头报告。
words.en: Relating to the mouth; spoken rather than written.

words.ex: The country has an agrarian economy.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家有一个农业经济。
words.en: Relating to land, especially agricultural land, or to the ownership or division of such land.

words.ex: He likes to study philosophy in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间学习哲学。
words.en: Philosophy is the study or creation of theories about basic things such as the nature of existence, knowledge, and thought, or about how people should live.

words.tr: n. 资产流动性；资产变现能力
words.ex: The company is facing a liquidity crisis due to the sudden drop in sales.
words.ex_cn: 由于销售额的突然下降，该公司正面临流动性危机。
words.en: Liquidity refers to the availability of liquid assets to a market or company. Liquid assets are those that can be quickly converted into cash without significantly affecting their value.

words.ex: The problem arises from a simple mistake.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题源于一个简单的错误。
words.en: If a situation or problem arises from a particular event or activity, it is caused by it.

words.tr:
n. 过氧化物
v. 用过氧化氢漂
words.ex: She used peroxide to lighten her hair.
words.ex_cn: 她用过氧化氢来漂白头发。
words.en: A peroxide is a compound containing the bivalent group -O-O- in which the oxygen atoms are bonded to each other and to other atoms or groups. It is used especially as a bleach or an oxidizing agent.

words.ex: His fate is inextricably tied to the land.
words.ex_cn: 他的命运与这片土地不可分开地联系在一起。
words.en: In a way that is impossible to disentangle or separate from something else.

words.tr:
n. 毛毯；厚的覆盖物；
adj. 包括所有的；
words.ex: He wrapped himself in a warm blanket.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己裹在一条温暖的毛毯里。
words.en: A blanket is a large piece of woolen or similar material used as a covering on a bed or elsewhere for warmth.

words.ex: The camera has a clear lens.
words.ex_cn: 这台相机有一个清晰的透镜。
words.en: A lens is a piece of curved glass or other transparent substance that is used in things such as cameras, telescopes, or pairs of glasses to make images larger or smaller.

words.ex: His exuberance made the party fun for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的热情洋溢让派对对每个人都很有趣。
words.en: Exuberance is the state of being full of energy, excitement, and cheerfulness, or the quality of being full of growth and vitality.

words.ex: The car accident caused one fatality.
words.ex_cn: 这场车祸导致一人死亡。
words.en: A fatality is a death caused by an accident or by violence, or is the fact of causing death.

words.tr: phrase. 在…方面取得进展；在…上取得进步
words.ex: He is making progress in learning English.
words.ex_cn: 他在学习英语方面取得了进步。
words.en: To improve or advance in skill, knowledge, or condition.

words.ex: The storm caused a brutal flood that destroyed many homes.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴引发了残酷的洪水，摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A brutal act or person is cruel and violent.

words.ex: She uses moisturizer every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上使用保湿霜。
words.en: A moisturizer is a cosmetic preparation used to prevent dryness in the skin.

words.tr: phrase. 肉眼（指不借助望远镜、显微镜等仪器的视力）
words.ex: The stars are not visible to the naked eye.
words.ex_cn: 星星用肉眼是看不见的。
words.en: If you see something with the naked eye, you see it without using any device such as a telescope or microscope.

words.tr:
v. 促进；使增长；
n. 提高；增强；
words.ex: Exercise can boost your energy.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进你的精力。
words.en: If one thing boosts another, it causes it to increase, improve, or be more successful.

words.tr: adj. 富有成效的；多产的；生产的；
words.ex: He had a productive day and finished all his work.
words.ex_cn: 他度过了富有成效的一天，完成了所有工作。
words.en: Producing or able to produce large amounts of goods, crops, or other commodities.

words.tr:
n. 委员会；佣金；
v. 委托；
words.ex: The commission met to discuss the new law.
words.ex_cn: 委员会开会讨论新法律。
words.en: A commission is a group of people who have been appointed to find out about something or to control something, or the act of doing this. It can also refer to a sum of money that is paid to someone for selling something, which is usually a percentage of the value of the goods sold.

words.ex: He steers the team toward success.
words.ex_cn: 他引导团队走向成功。
words.en: To steer a vehicle, ship, or aircraft is to control its direction.

words.ex: The elephant is gigantic compared to a dog.
words.ex_cn: 这头大象相比狗来说是巨大的。
words.en: If you describe something as gigantic, you are emphasizing that it is extremely large in size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: The ozone layer protects us from the sun's harmful rays.
words.ex_cn: 臭氧层保护我们免受太阳有害射线的伤害。
words.en: Ozone is a form of oxygen that has three atoms in each molecule, and it is a pale blue gas with a pungent smell. It is found in the Earth's atmosphere and absorbs ultraviolet radiation, which is harmful to living organisms.

words.ex: His physiological response to stress is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 他对压力的生理反应非常强烈。
words.en: Physiological refers to the normal functions of living organisms and their parts, or to the branch of biology that deals with these functions.

words.ex: The climate in summer is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 夏天的气候非常炎热。
words.en: The climate of a place is the general weather conditions that are typical of it.

words.ex: The aboriginal people live in the forests of Australia.
words.ex_cn: 土著居民生活在澳大利亚的森林里。
words.en: An aboriginal person or thing is one that has been in a country or region from the earliest known times or from before the arrival of colonists.

words.tr: phrase. 警告某人某事；提醒某人注意某事
words.ex: I warn him of the danger every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天都警告他有危险。
words.en: To inform someone in advance of a possible danger, problem, or other unpleasant situation.

words.ex: He was late because of the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他因为公交车而迟到了。
words.en: You use 'because of' to introduce the reason or explanation for something.

words.ex: He needs to adjust to the new school.
words.ex_cn: 他需要适应新学校。
words.en: If you adjust to a new situation or get used to it, you change your behaviour or ideas so that you can deal with it successfully.

words.ex: He is receiving therapy for his back pain.
words.ex_cn: 他正在接受治疗以缓解背痛。
words.en: Therapy is the treatment of someone with mental or physical illness without the use of drugs or operations.

words.ex: He is referred to as a genius by his teachers.
words.ex_cn: 他的老师称他为天才。
words.en: to be called or known by a particular name or title

words.tr: adj. 鲁莽的；不计后果的；
words.ex: He drove reckless and got into an accident.
words.ex_cn: 他开车鲁莽，结果出了事故。
words.en: If you say that someone is reckless, you mean that they act in a way which shows that they do not care about danger or the effect their behaviour will have on other people.

words.ex: The teacher gave a clear description of the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 老师对实验做了清晰的描述。
words.en: A description of someone or something is a statement that explains what they are or what they are like.

words.ex: The ancient symbol remains an enigma.
words.ex_cn: 这个古代符号仍然是一个谜。
words.en: An enigma is something that is mysterious and difficult to understand.

words.tr: phrase. v. 关闭；停业；终止运营
words.ex: The shop will close down next week.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店将在下周关门。
words.en: If a business or organization closes down or if someone closes it down, it stops operating permanently.

words.ex: The dark forest looks scary at night.
words.ex_cn: 这个黑暗的森林在晚上看起来吓人。
words.en: If something is scary, it causes fear or alarm.

words.tr: n. 一阵强劲的气流；爆炸；
words.ex: A blast of cold wind hit the window.
words.ex_cn: 一阵冷风击中了窗户。
words.en: A blast is a sudden loud noise or a strong gust of wind. It can also refer to an explosion or the act of blowing something up. As a verb, it means to explode or to criticize severely.

words.tr: phrase. 指明方向；指出道路；为…指明途径
words.ex: The teacher points the way to success with hard work.
words.ex_cn: 老师指出努力工作是通往成功之路。
words.en: To indicate or show the direction or path towards something.

words.tr: phrase. 社会经济阶层；指基于收入、教育和职业等因素划分的社会群体
words.ex: He was born into a low socio-economic class.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个低收入社会阶层。
words.en: A group in society defined by its members' economic and social status.

words.ex: The price of bread went up because of inflation.
words.ex_cn: 由于通货膨胀，面包的价格上涨了。
words.en: Inflation is a general increase in prices and fall in the purchasing value of money.

words.tr: adj. 流传甚广的；分布广的；
words.ex: The flu became widespread last winter.
words.ex_cn: 去年冬天流感流传甚广。
words.en: Something that is widespread exists or happens over a large area, or to a great extent.

words.ex: His words were contradictory.
words.ex_cn: 他的话是矛盾的。
words.en: If two or more facts, ideas, or statements are contradictory, they state or imply that opposite things are true.

words.ex: He took his words in a literal sense.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的话按字面意思理解。
words.en: If you describe something as the literal truth or a literal fact, you are emphasizing that it is true.

words.tr:
n. 吸引力；上诉；
v. 吸引；诉请；呼吁；
words.ex: The appeal of the beach drew many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 海滩的吸引力吸引了许多游客。
words.en: If you appeal to someone to do something, you make a serious and urgent request to them. If you appeal against a decision or sentence, you formally ask a court or other authority to change it. If something appeals to you, you like it or it interests you.

words.tr: adj. 刻板的；坚硬的；严格的；
words.ex: He has a rigid attitude toward rules.
words.ex_cn: 他对规则的态度很刻板。
words.en: not able to be changed or adapted; not able to be bent or moved; stiff

words.tr: adj. 分歧的；发散的；趋异的；
words.ex: The two friends had divergent opinions about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 这两个朋友对这部电影的看法不同。
words.en: If two things diverge, they are different from each other, or they become different from each other.

words.tr:
n. 皱纹
v. 起皱纹；弄皱…
words.ex: He has a deep wrinkle on his forehead.
words.ex_cn: 他的额头上有一道深深的皱纹。
words.en: A wrinkle is a small line or fold in something, especially fabric or the skin.

words.tr: phrase. 因果关系；原因和结果
words.ex: The rain caused the road to be wet. This is cause and effect.
words.ex_cn: 下雨导致道路变湿。这就是因果关系。
words.en: A relationship between events or things, where one is the result of the other or others.

words.tr: n. 仔细研究；详细检查；
words.ex: The teacher examined the student's work under close scrutiny.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作业进行了仔细研究。
words.en: If someone or something is under scrutiny, they are being studied or observed very carefully.

words.tr: phrase. 结果是；原来是；证实是
words.ex: The shy boy turned out to be a great singer.
words.ex_cn: 那个害羞的男孩结果是个很棒的歌手。
words.en: If something turns out to be a particular thing, it is discovered to be that thing.

words.tr:
adj. 文明的；开化的；有法制伦理的
v. 使开化；使文明；教化；“civilize”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He lives in a civilized society.
words.ex_cn: 他生活在一个文明的社会中。
words.en: Someone who is civilized is polite and reasonable.

words.ex: He will initiate a new project next week.
words.ex_cn: 他将在下周发起一个新项目。
words.en: To initiate something means to start it or cause it to happen.

words.ex: He gave a precise answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了准确的答案。
words.en: If you give precise information or precise instructions, you give exact details so that there is no confusion about what should be done.

words.ex: The visa application requires a lot of formality.
words.ex_cn: 签证申请需要很多正式手续。
words.en: A formality is something that is done as part of a formal process or procedure, often without much thought or feeling because it is expected.

words.ex: The storm caused disorientation among the hikers.
words.ex_cn: 风暴让徒步者们迷失了方向。
words.en: A state of confusion about where you are, where you are going, or what is happening around you.

words.ex: He took responsibility for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了这个错误的责任。
words.en: If you have responsibility for something or someone, or if they are your responsibility, it is your job or duty to deal with them and to take decisions relating to them.

words.ex: The teacher gave a cue to start the game.
words.ex_cn: 老师给出了开始游戏的提示。
words.en: A cue is a signal for someone to do something, or a piece of information that helps someone to understand something.

words.ex: Globalization helps countries trade more easily.
words.ex_cn: 全球化帮助各国更容易地进行贸易。
words.en: The process by which businesses or other organizations develop international influence or start operating on an international scale.

words.ex: He plays the cello every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上拉大提琴。
words.en: A cello is a large stringed instrument of the violin family, tuned an octave below the viola.

words.ex: He used a match to ignite the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他用火柴点燃了火。
words.en: If you ignite something or if it ignites, it starts burning or explodes.

words.ex: The ancient temple has a tall stone column.
words.ex_cn: 这座古庙有一根高大的石柱。
words.en: A column is a tall solid upright stone post used to support a building or as a monument.

words.ex: He was labeled as a troublemaker by his teachers.
words.ex_cn: v. 他被老师们标记为麻烦制造者。
words.en: To be categorized or described in a particular way, especially unfairly or inaccurately.

words.ex: He ties his shoelaces before running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步前系鞋带。
words.en: To fasten or secure with or as if with a cord, rope, or strap.
